items.title: AI errors, inflated prices: Tamil Nadu govt orders probe into Periyar library books
items.excerpt: Tamil Nadu ordered a probe after writer Perumal Murugan flagged suspected AI-generated books, phantom authors and factual errors among titles bought for the new Periyar Arivulagam library in Coimbatore.
items.rationale: Concrete government action: a state-ordered probe after AI-generated slop reached a public library's acquisitions, a first-of-its-kind procurement consequence.

items.title: Proudly Human Promises to Certify AI-Free Books
items.excerpt: Australian startup Proudly Human, founded by former chief scientist Alan Finkel, joins a growing field of services certifying books as written without AI assistance; Finkel says two of the Big Five are in talks.
items.rationale: New certification service launch with Big Five talks; distinct from earlier UK IPO mark and Organic Literature stories.

items.title: University libraries are being swarmed by AI bots, putting public access at risk
items.excerpt: Academic libraries are fighting swarms of AI data-scraping bots that slow or crash digital collections meant for students, researchers and the public.
items.rationale: Fresh reporting on AI scrapers degrading library digital collections; no prior coverage in the section.

items.title: 내 독서 취향은 무슨 빵?…영풍문고, AI 도서 추천 '책빵집' 출시
items.excerpt: 영풍문고가 온라인 이용 기록과 전국 매장 판매 데이터를 함께 분석해 8가지 '빵' 독서 유형별로 책을 추천하는 AI 서비스 'AI 책빵집'을 내놨다.
items.rationale: New product release: a major Korean bookstore chain's AI recommendation service combining online and in-store sales data.

items.title: What AI can lose when it makes Holocaust writings easier to read
items.excerpt: A Tel Aviv University study in AI & Society ran three Holocaust writings through AI enhancement, handwriting recognition, correction and translation, finding gains in access but losses in material evidence.
items.rationale: New peer-reviewed study on what AI transcription/translation gains and loses for historical manuscripts; not in science history or today's science pool.
